title: BAYANGKAN JIKA KAMU
BISA MENDENGAR PIKIRAN?

power.rule: you hear the thoughts of every mind near you, and you can count them

script.text: Bayangkan jika kamu bisa mendengar pikiran orang.
Ibu menyembunyikan kue. Kamu dengar. Ketemu.
Temanmu tahu jawabannya. Kamu dengar. Nilai seratus.
Manusia punya lebih dari enam ribu pikiran sehari. Itu nyata.

script.beat: 4 the rule that sets up the twist

script.text: Padahal di rumah cuma kalian bertiga.
Dan pikiran keempat itu... baru sadar kamu mendengarnya.

science.claim: A person has more than six thousand thoughts a day.
science.working: Tseng and Poppenk tracked transitions between brain-activity 'meta-states' (thought worms) in fMRI of 184 people; Queen's University reported the average at about 6,200 new thoughts a day. 6,200 > 6,000, so 'lebih dari enam ribu' holds. It is an estimate from one lab study; the schematic credits it.
science.source: Tseng & Poppenk, Nature Communications 11, 3480 (2020), doi:10.1038/s41467-020-17255-9; Queen's University Gazette, 'Discovery of thought worms opens window to the mind', July 2020
